Lemma
[Perelman's first variation formula for $\mathcal F$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0053 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch17-modified-scalar-variation 1. ch17:17.30\group Variation Formulas

Under the same variation, \[ \partial _s\mathcal F(g,f)=-\int _{\mathcal M} \langle v,\Ric + abla ^2f angle e^{-f}d\mu =-\int _{\mathcal M}L(v, abla f)e^{-f}d\mu . \]
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the modified-scalar formula for $\mathcal F$ and use that $e^{-f}d\mu $ is fixed. Weighted integration by parts makes the integral of $L(v, abla f)$ equal to the integral of $\langle v,\Ric + abla ^2f angle $.

□
